clips.title: The story
paras: In Teldrassil, Inscribed Bark carries word of the World Tree's state to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm. The Oracle Tree entrusts it with news of the boughs and the threats troubling the woods.

The Oracle Tree sends Inscribed Bark to the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus. After you drive the harpies from their nests, the ancient tree gives you its message, wary of sending ordinary couriers along Teldrassil's tainted paths. The report tells Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm of recent victories and the deeper blight still gripping the woods.
